falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,700 on any single day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break below the August 2024 low (4,742) and through the 4,700 psychological level would invalidate the bottom_2024_aug pattern match, proving this is not a similar bottom formation but rather a continuation of the downtrend or a new breakdown structure

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom featured VIX peaking near 28 and rapidly declining; sustained VIX above 35 would indicate panic selling not present in the reference pattern, invalidating the 75% pattern match and suggesting a more severe correction than August 2024

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% while S&P 500 simultaneously drops more than 2% on the same day
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This would signal a flight-to-safety recession scare rather than a growth-scare bottom; the August 2024 bottom saw yields stable/rising with equities recovering, so this divergence would prove the current macro driver is fundamentally different

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
